title: Nullivance Logic: formal development and reproducible manuscripts
description:
Lean 4 formalization and reproducibility artifact for nullivance logic (NPL). This version supersedes the preliminary Version 1 report with a proof-oriented development: propositional two-channel semantics, exact threshold projection to FOUR, a four-signed tableau with verified soundness and completeness, terminating operational proof search with countermodels and progressing-schedule independence, and a finite-domain quantified layer with a verified complete macro-free extensional core tableau. It also retains checked counterexamples refuting two older head-sensitive replay-certificate conjectures and verifies a separate complete membership-selecting repair.

Release 0.7.1 is pinned to Lean 4.32.1 and mathlib v4.32.1 at commit 520045ab14e26149ee970e2e617ca04b09bde5d6. The deposit includes two manuscripts, the exact tagged source archive, and its SHA-256 sidecar. See ARTIFACT.md and run pwsh ./scripts/Verify-Release.ps1.
notes: Repository: https://github.com/lamtung0487-droid/nullivance-logic. Version DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21964600. The source package is generated from annotated tag v0.7.1 with scripts/New-ReleasePackage.ps1 and accompanied by a SHA-256 checksum.
